grammar_title: 过去分词复习(Review of Past Participles:作定语 / 作状语 / 作宾补与表语)
source: 人教版2019选择性必修四 Unit 2 Review useful structures:过去分词(done)的用法复习。过去分词=被动/完成,逻辑主语是动作承受者;干扰项 doing(主动/进行)/to do/do。句子标志性景点·建筑奇迹·旅游主题,地道、答案唯一。

points.point: 过去分词作定语(被动/完成,前置或后置 = 定语从句)
points.overview: 过去分词作定语,表被动或已完成,逻辑主语是动作承受者:前置如 a ruined castle;后置如 a bridge built in 1920(= which was built)。被修饰名词是动作的承受者用 done;若名词主动发出动作则用 doing。

points.point: 过去分词作状语(被动/完成,句首或句中)
points.overview: 过去分词作状语,其逻辑主语是句子主语,且主语承受该动作(被动)时用 done:Built of stone, the tower has lasted centuries. / Seen from the air, the site looks stunning. 若主语主动发出动作则用 doing。

points.point: 过去分词作宾语补足语 / 表语(与 doing 对照)
points.overview: have/get sth done(让某事被做完)、see/find/keep sth done(宾语承受动作);作表语如 the gate remained closed(处于被动/完成状态)。宾语或主语主动进行动作时才用 doing。

questions.stem: We visited a ruined castle ____ on a hill above the old town.
questions.explanation: castle 是被'坐落'的承受者,表状态/被动,后置定语用过去分词 located(= which is located)。

questions.stem: The bridge ____ in 1920 is still one of the city's most iconic sights.
questions.explanation: bridge 是被'建造'的对象,表被动+完成,后置定语用 built(= which was built)。

questions.stem: Tourists love the old streets ____ with grey stone hundreds of years ago.
questions.explanation: streets 被'铺',被动+完成,后置定语用 paved。

questions.stem: Inside the museum you can see ancient symbols ____ onto animal bones.
questions.explanation: symbols 是被'刻'的对象,被动用 carved。

questions.stem: The didgeridoo is made from a tree branch ____ out by nature.
questions.explanation: branch 被'掏空',被动+完成,后置定语用 hollowed。

questions.stem: It is a quiet seaside town ____ far from the busy capital.
questions.explanation: town 被'坐落',表状态,后置定语用 situated。

questions.stem: The stadium ____ the "Bird's Nest" can hold eighty thousand people.
questions.explanation: stadium 被'称为',被动用 called(= which is called)。

questions.stem: We took photos of the famous gate ____ of white marble.
questions.explanation: gate 由大理石'制成',被动用 made(of)。

questions.stem: The temple has a long history ____ back to the Tang Dynasty.
questions.explanation: history 主动'追溯',date back 是主动含义,用现在分词 dating;这里强调'本身向前回溯'的主动延伸,故 dating 才地道。

questions.stem: Visitors admired the grand palace ____ by thousands of workers long ago.
questions.explanation: palace 被'建造',被动+完成,后置定语用 built。

questions.stem: The old prison, now ____ into a museum, draws many curious tourists.
questions.explanation: prison 被'改造成',被动用 turned。

questions.stem: The channel ____ through the mountain still controls the river today.
questions.explanation: channel 被'开凿',被动+完成,后置定语用过去分词 cut(cut 的过去分词同形)。

questions.stem: On the wall are the names of the engineers ____ in the tower's construction.
questions.explanation: engineers'被卷入/参与'用过去分词 involved 作后置定语(those involved in)。

questions.stem: The market sold goods ____ from many countries along the Silk Road.
questions.explanation: goods 被'带来',被动+完成,后置定语用 brought。

questions.stem: We walked along a path ____ with bright flowers on both sides.
questions.explanation: path 被花'镶边/排满',被动用 lined(be lined with)。

questions.stem: The koalas ____ for each session must be in a good state for human contact.
questions.explanation: koalas 被'挑选',被动用 selected(= which are selected)。

questions.stem: There is a giant fish-shaped construction ____ to control the water flow.
questions.explanation: construction 被'设计',被动用 designed。

questions.stem: The honey ____ in this remote valley is famous all over the world.
questions.explanation: honey 被'生产',被动+完成,后置定语用 produced。

questions.stem: It is a UNESCO heritage site ____ for over two thousand years.
questions.explanation: site 被'保护/保存',被动用 preserved。

questions.stem: Tourists enjoy the clear blue water ____ by long sandy beaches.
questions.explanation: water 被沙滩'环绕',被动用 surrounded(= which is surrounded)。

questions.stem: ____ of stone, the ancient tower has lasted for many centuries.
questions.explanation: 句子主语 tower 是被'建造'的对象(被动),状语用过去分词 Built(= As it was built)。

questions.stem: ____ from the air, the heritage site looks truly stunning.
questions.explanation: 主语 site 被'看',被动,状语用 Seen(= When it is seen)。

questions.stem: ____ to the south of the equator, the country enjoys warm weather all year.
questions.explanation: 主语 country 被'定位/坐落',状语用 Located(= As it is located)。

questions.stem: ____ by Chinese culture, many cities now have Chinatowns that attract tourists.
questions.explanation: 主语 cities 被'影响',被动,状语用 Influenced。

questions.stem: ____ as the home of golf, Scotland is a perfect place for a relaxing holiday.
questions.explanation: 主语 Scotland 被'知晓/誉为',被动,状语用 Known(be known as)。

questions.stem: ____ by the first European settlers, the Sunday roast is now typical Australian food.
questions.explanation: 主语 roast 被'引入',被动,状语用 Introduced。

questions.stem: ____ originally as a temporary structure, the tower was nearly taken down.
questions.explanation: 主语 tower 被'规划',被动,状语用 Planned。

questions.stem: ____ around 256 BCE, Dujiangyan is still in use as an irrigation system today.
questions.explanation: 主语 Dujiangyan 被'建造',被动+完成,状语用 Constructed。

questions.stem: ____ from this lookout, the whole bay seems to glow in the morning light.
questions.explanation: 主语 bay 被'看/观赏',被动,状语用 Viewed。

questions.stem: ____ by tall mountains on three sides, the old town is hard to reach.
questions.explanation: 主语 town 被山'环绕',被动,状语用 Surrounded。

questions.stem: ____ deep in the rainforest, the waterfall is a hidden getaway for hikers.
questions.explanation: 主语 waterfall 被'隐藏',被动,状语用 Hidden。

questions.stem: ____ with bright lights at night, the bridge becomes the city's main attraction.
questions.explanation: 主语 bridge 被灯光'点亮',被动,状语用 Lit。

questions.stem: ____ as a world heritage site, the old city now welcomes more visitors than ever.
questions.explanation: 主语 city 被'认定',被动,状语用 Recognised。

questions.stem: ____ for hundreds of years, these old walls still stand strong today.
questions.explanation: 主语 walls 被'使用',被动,状语用 Used(注意'standing'主动但语义不搭后续 still stand);最贴切是 Used。

questions.stem: ____ of white marble, the grand gate shines under the bright sun.
questions.explanation: 主语 gate 由大理石'制成',被动,状语用 Made(be made of)。

questions.stem: ____ to protect the wild animals, the park has set up strong fences.
questions.explanation: 主语 park 被'设计/建立'以保护动物,被动,状语用 Designed。

questions.stem: ____ by immigrants from many lands, the city offers food from all over the world.
questions.explanation: 主语 city 被移民'塑造',被动,状语用 Shaped。

questions.stem: ____ in the heart of the desert, the small town feels far from everywhere.
questions.explanation: 主语 town 被'置于/坐落',被动,状语用 Set。

questions.stem: ____ along the coast for miles, the road gives drivers an amazing ocean view.
questions.explanation: 主语 road 被'修建',被动,状语用 Built。

questions.stem: ____ carefully over many years, the gardens have become a famous attraction.
questions.explanation: 主语 gardens 被'栽种/打理',被动,状语用 Planted。

questions.stem: After the storm, the workers found the temple gate ____ by a fallen tree.
questions.explanation: see/find sth done:gate 被树'堵住',宾补用过去分词 blocked。

questions.stem: At night the staff keep the old museum's heavy doors ____ for safety.
questions.explanation: keep sth done:doors 被'锁上',宾补用 locked。

questions.stem: The city wants to have the ancient bridge ____ before the festival begins.
questions.explanation: have sth done:bridge 被'修好',宾补用 repaired。

questions.stem: When we reached the top, we saw the whole valley ____ in golden light.
questions.explanation: see sth done:valley 被光'沐浴',宾补用 bathed。

questions.stem: Tourists usually want their photos ____ in front of the famous statue.
questions.explanation: want sth done:photos 被'拍',宾补用 taken。

questions.stem: Be careful with the old steps; the entrance often remains ____ after heavy rain.
questions.explanation: remain + 表语:entrance 处于被'淹'的状态,用过去分词 flooded。

questions.stem: The guide had the gates of the palace ____ so visitors could enter.
questions.explanation: have sth done:gates 被'打开',宾补用 opened。

questions.stem: After many years, the once-grand fort now lies ____ and forgotten.
questions.explanation: lie + 表语:fort 处于被'毁'的状态,用 ruined。

questions.stem: The koalas are handled only briefly, and visitors find them ____ from too much contact.
questions.explanation: find sth done:koalas 被'弄得紧张',宾补用过去分词 stressed。

questions.stem: The town keeps its old market square ____ exactly as it was a century ago.
questions.explanation: keep sth done:square 被'保存',宾补用 preserved。

questions.stem: Before the tour, the manager wants the path ____ of any rubbish.
questions.explanation: want sth done:path 被'清理',宾补用 cleared。

questions.stem: When the lights went out, the whole hall suddenly became ____ in darkness.
questions.explanation: become + 表语:hall 被黑暗'笼罩',用过去分词 covered。

questions.stem: The festival organisers had hundreds of lanterns ____ along the river bank.
questions.explanation: have sth done:lanterns 被'挂起',宾补用过去分词 hung。

questions.stem: After the long winter, the mountain gate stays ____ until spring arrives.
questions.explanation: stay + 表语:gate 处于被'关闭'的状态,用 closed。

questions.stem: Visitors should get their tickets ____ at the booth before entering the site.
questions.explanation: get sth done:tickets 被'查验',宾补用 checked。

questions.stem: From the boat we watched the cliffs slowly ____ by the evening mist.
questions.explanation: watch sth done:cliffs 被雾'遮住',宾补用 hidden。

questions.stem: The city had its old harbour walls ____ to keep the heritage area safe.
questions.explanation: have sth done:walls 被'加固',宾补用 strengthened。

questions.stem: During the festival, the ancient temple remained ____ to the public all night.
questions.explanation: remain + 表语:此处表'(由人)被开放',用过去分词 opened 表被动状态。

questions.stem: We found the famous fountain ____ off because of repairs that week.
questions.explanation: find sth done:fountain 被'关掉',宾补用 switched(switch off)。

questions.stem: The guide wants every visitor ____ about the rules before the tour starts.
questions.explanation: want sb done(被告知):visitor 被'告知',宾补用过去分词 told。
